text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin's racing outfit has arrived.
The cool, streetwear-style outfit brings out
her sharpness even more.
choice_data_list: I'm glad we gave our design requests.
I'm glad you put in your design requests.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Well... obviously.
It'd be annoying to get clothes that don't even fit.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: "How I feel hasn't changed since then either, so—"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Taishin, Taishin, Taaishiiin!!
Is it true you're getting your Racewear!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Taishin, all your hard work paid off...!
I'm zzo glad for youuuu~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh, so loud!
Don't both of you go yelling at the same time.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's a joyous occasion, after all.
It's only natural to get a bit excited.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "So, what are we going to do about the racing outfit design?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
According to the magazines,
this seems to be the latest trend, but—
On the page Biwa Hayahide showed me were eye-catching, glittering outfits and cute costumes that would look great on stage.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Reject all of them.
Stuff like this just isn't my style.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I... don't want anything like that.
I'd rather wear something casual like what I usually wear.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? It's your racing outfit, you know?
Shouldn't it be something super flashy and amazing!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Dressing up in gaudy outfits feels like
I can't win without relying on clothes, and I hate that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I want to be myself, just like always.
—I'm going to get stronger through my own power.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see. So the racing outfit serves as proof of that.
Not a bad theory, Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I got swept up in the mood and said
too much... Well, it wasn't a lie anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I won't flatter anyone, and I won't rely on anything.
...I'll win this race with my own strength alone!
choice_data_list: This is where the real start begins!
This is where the real start begins, right!
But I want you to rely on me
Still, I want you to rely on me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I won't flatter anyone, and I won't rely on anything.
...I'll win this race with my own strength alone!
choice_data_list: This is where the real start begins!
This is where the real start begins, right!
But I want you to rely on me
Still, I want you to rely on me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hmph, I already knew that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: "I've finally made it far enough to catch everyone's eye..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"I'm going to climb all the way
to the very pinnacle of the Twinkle Series like this!"
choice_data_list: Yeah! I'll stay with you all the way!!
Yeah! I'll stay with you all the way!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...No, you don't need to be
so eager about it yourself."

Afterward, at Narita Taishin's request to run and break in her outfit,
we headed over to the training course.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Isn't Taishin-senpai amazing today?
It's like she's way more intense wearing her racing racewear...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Just looking at it feels like getting swallowed up!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Feeling like you'll be swallowed whole, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Bring it on...!
Then I'll sink my teeth into everything and swallow it whole!!)
And thus, the beacon of her rebellion roared to life once more.

I told her that a trainer exists
to support Narita Taishin and help her grow stronger.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh, maybe if I feel like it.
It's not like I need to play nice anyway."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I will grow strong by my own will.
And you will support me by yours.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: That's all it is, right?
choice_data_list: That's fine. Let's get stronger together.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ……Mm.

Though she seemed somewhat reluctant, she gave a nod.
It seemed she had at least acknowledged my existence as a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what are you grinning at?
If you're thinking something weird, I'm kicking you!
There are still plenty of hurdles to overcome, and I can't say I've built a flawless bond of trust with Narita Taishin yet, but—

We vowed in our hearts
to keep moving forward in our own way.
